flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list (not in approved.json until Peace posts /approve-rule on its proposal issue)
engine: the v1/v2 engine (peaceai/lib/derive.ts, peaceai/lib/learned-derive.ts) with the rule param placement end-of-existing-module, bound to DERIVE_APPEND_TRIGGER: the same search (v1 first, then v2 label chains) and every v1/v2 gate, then the derived function is appended to the named existing module (old text unchanged, one blank line, the function at the very end) plus one new test file; appendTargetProblem checks the module before the search and derivedAppendProblem re-checks the result; Job B (test-candidates.ts) re-checks the append against the base commit's text and runs the module's existing tests and the new test confined to the module's closure; the review note is rebuilt from an append diff
scope: an issue whose header reads 'Append a new function NAME(params): type to the existing module src/....ts' with behavior prose and literal examples, naming a module that exists (exact path) in src/ outside protected, denied, test, fixture, .d.ts and self-protected paths; one function with a single return expression from the v1/v2 vocabulary; imports are never added or changed
refusals: every v1/v2 refusal (not_needed is not applied to appends: a v1-derivable function appended to an existing module is the point); target_file_not_found (missing module or case near-miss; v3 never creates one); derive_path; derive_append_layout (CRLF, no final newline, a trailing blank line, empty); derive_append_parse; derive_append_name_collision (any identifier, word in the text, export * or export * as); derive_append_mutable_state (top-level let / var / using); derive_append_side_effects (anything the module or its import closure runs at import, a package or unresolved import, export default of an expression); derive_append_not_add_only; derive_params (a spec pairing a placement with the other placement's trigger); new_test_path_exists; denied_path (repo deny patterns via applyRule)

evidence.method: the v1 evidence, unchanged (no entry added or removed). v3 changes where the derived function goes, not which functions can be derived: the search, the vocabulary, the size bound and every evidence gate are the v1/v2 ones; the append is argued safe by construction (add-only text, refused on collisions, mutable state and import-time code; the module's own tests must still pass in Job B)
evidence.note: For Auditor: v3 does not widen what can be derived; it widens where (an existing module). See peaceai/docs/m112-append-to-existing-module.md.
